inferred: Compared with primary tumors (n = 26), bone metastases were more heterogeneous and showed increased levels of proteins involved in cell-cycle progression, DNA damage response, RNA processing, and fatty acid β-oxidation; and reduced levels of proteins were related to cell adhesion and carbohydrate metabolism.
